kv5.10:3.3: atthi sāvakassa khandhapaññatti āyatanapaññatti dhātupaññatti saccapaññatti indriyapaññatti puggalapaññattīti.
kv5.10:4.3: sāvako jino satthā sammāsambuddho sabbaññū sabbadassāvī dhammasāmī dhammapaṭisaraṇoti.
kv5.10:5.3: sāvako anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā asañjātassa maggassa sañjanetā anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā maggaññū maggavidū maggakovidoti.
kv5.10:6.6: tena hi sāvakassa phale ñāṇaṃ atthīti.
kv5.10:7.1: vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttaṃ sekkhassa asekkhaṃ ñāṇaṃ viparīteñāṇaṃ aniyatassa niyāmagamanāya atthi ñāṇaṃ sabbaṃ ñāṇaṃ paṭisambhidāti sammatiñāṇaṃ cetopariyāye ñāṇaṃ anāgate ñāṇaṃ paccuppanne ñāṇaṃ sāvakassa phale ñāṇanti.
kv5.10:8.1: upahāro balaṃ gihissa arahā ca vimuttipañcamaṃ.
